# compute_psds_pocketwise_rust { #mofography.rust_fun.compute_psds_pocketwise_rust }

```python
rust_fun.compute_psds_pocketwise_rust(
    dgrid,
    regions_pbc,
    ase_atoms,
    num_samples_per_region=1000,
    bins=None,
    return_fig=False,
    material='Material',
    probe_center_min_radius=None,
)
```

Compute pore size distributions for each pocket/region.

This function creates separate pore size distributions for each identified
pore region and optionally generates a visualization plot.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                   | Type                  | Description                                                    | Default      |
|------------------------|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| dgrid                  | numpy.ndarray         | 3D distance grid from dgrid_from_atoms_rust                    | _required_   |
| regions_pbc            | numpy.ndarray         | 3D array of region labels from periodic segmentation           | _required_   |
| ase_atoms              | ase.Atoms             | ASE Atoms object of the material                               | _required_   |
| num_samples_per_region | int                   | Number of sample points per region                             | `1000`       |
| bins                   | numpy.ndarray \| None | Bin edges for histogram. If None, uses np.linspace(0, 50, 200) | `None`       |
| return_fig             | bool                  | Whether to return a plotly figure along with the PSDs          | `False`      |
| material               | str                   | Name of the material for plot title                            | `'Material'` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description                                                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict \| tuple\[dict, plotly.graph_objects.Figure\] | If return_fig is False, returns pocket PSDs dictionary. If True, returns (pocket_psds, figure) |
